@q{“Its ribs shall be crowbars that let light pass inside like the sun's rays. Knotted at both its hips shall be city-destroying slingstones. Its great haunches shall be dripping knives, covered with gore, that make blood flow. Its muscles shall be saws that slash, its feet those of an eagle. It shall make the @wWN{Tigris} and @wWN{Euphrates} quaver, it shall make the mountains rumble. At its reverberation the hills shall be uprooted, the people shall be pitched about like sheaves, @wGN{Sumer} and @wGN{Akkad} shall shiver, they shall be flooded like a harvest crop. @q{“But the sensible shall beat their breasts and droop their heads. At midnight they shall be afraid and tearful, and suffer insomnia. Lady @wDN{Inana} whose greatness is vaster than the mountains, hovering like @wDN{An}, vested with grandeur like @wDN{Enlil}, like her father, perfect by night and in the heat of the day, like @wDN{Utu}, surpassing in vigour, singularly exalted in all the four regions -- let @wRN{Išme-@wDN{Dagan}} take pleasure in relaxing in your temple, let him murmer to you in your temple, let him raise his head to you in your @wTN{E-ana}.

Let @wRN{Išme-@wDN{Dagan}} serve you as your steward. Let him prepare great bulls for you. Let him dedicate great offerings to you. Let him make the beer, fat and oil plentiful for you. Let him make syrup and wine flow for you as from stone jars. Let @wRN{Išme-@wDN{Dagan}}, son of @wDN{Enlil} on the king's pedestal, bow in homage to you. If the @wDN{Anuna} gods emerge tearfully, let them promise to us that as it was when heaven and earth came about, nothing of that time shall be changed. If @wDN{An} looks kindly upon that man and at the well-built city, the place of determining fate, proclaim @q[Inana,]{“Man and city! Life and well-being!”} for him. Let praise ring out. Let him be made surpassing above all, to his right or left. Tireless @fsux{lamma} deity, take hold of his head, pronounce his fate in charitable words -- by the command of @wDN{An} and @wDN{Enlil} it will remain unaltered for a long time.
